title: Repeated parameter tags are a documentation-policy violation

ground_truth.statement: phpDocumentor specifies at most one @param per argument. The repeated tag violates that policy even though both tags agree and PHP executes the body unchanged. Runtime only establishes comment erasure, not the policy.

provenance.note: Duplicate prefixed tags normalized to standard @param, preserving the independently documented duplicate-tag policy.

notes: This compares documentation validation policy, not PHP safety. An absent diagnostic does not establish unsupported status. Single-tag control is line 9.
